card.name: Ingoma ya Mapiko
card.profile: Masked celebratory dance of the Makonde, central to puberty-to-adulthood initiation; masked male dancers, drums and provocative call-and-response choir. UNESCO Urgent Safeguarding 2023 — insurgency in Cabo Delgado halted festivals. Sacred initiation = ethnographic record.
